mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Sunlight</titleLeft><mainText>You are marked by Leona. Leona's allies will deal additional magic damage to you.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight debuff to deal additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Spells afflict enemies with <spellName>Sunlight</spellName> for @MarkDuration@ seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those enemies, they deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, consuming <spellName>Sunlight</spellName>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Solar Barrier</titleLeft><mainText>Leona has increased Armor and Magic Resistance.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Leona raises her shield to gain Armor and Magic Resistance.  When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Leona gains <scaleArmor>@BonusARMR@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @BuffDuration@ seconds. When the effect ends, nearby enemies struck take <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and Leona retains her bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for another @BuffDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shield of Daybreak</titleLeft><mainText>Leona's next melee attack will stun and deal bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: The next basic attack deals an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stuns</status> an enemy for @StunDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Solar Barrier</titleLeft><mainText>Leona has increased Armor and Magic Resistance.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Leona raises her shield to gain Armor and Magic Resistance.  When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Leona gains <scaleArmor>@BonusARMR@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @BuffDuration@ seconds. When the effect ends, nearby enemies struck take <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and Leona retains her bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for another @BuffDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area.  Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing <magicDamage>@ExplosionCalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies by @SlowPercent@% for @CCDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are <status>Stunned</status>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Strikes all enemies in a line dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The last enemy Champion struck will be briefly <status>Rooted</status> and Leona will dash to them.
